sets_context.fix: One sentence of setup first -- the question you were asked, the data you had, the deadline or limit you were under. It is what makes the rest of the answer mean anything.

states_outcome.fix: Finish with the effect: what someone decided because of your analysis, what changed after it, what number moved. An analysis nobody acted on reads as an activity, not a result.

specific_detail.fix: Put a number on it. 'Churn fell from 6% to 4% in a quarter' is checkable; 'it improved a lot' is not, and the difference is what separates an anecdote from evidence.

measurement_stated.fix: Say how you know -- checked it against the source system, compared it with the same month last year, held out a control group. A number with a method behind it is worth several without.

answered_fully.label: Answered the question
answered_fully.note: Never ask the model this. Compute it.

specific_detail.label: Concrete rather than general

questions: To start — tell me a bit about yourself and what you're working on at the moment.
What drew you to this role in particular?
Describe a mistake you made at work, and what you did about it.
Tell me about a time you had to meet a tight deadline.
Tell me about a decision you made without all the information you wanted.
Tell me about a time you had to get up to speed quickly in an area you knew little about.
Tell me about an analysis you did that changed a decision someone was about to make.
Describe a time the data you were given turned out to be wrong or incomplete.
Tell me about a time you explained a finding to people without a data background.
Tell me about a dashboard or report you built. How did you know people used it?
Suppose weekly sign-ups dropped by twenty per cent last week and nobody knows why. How would you find out? Take a minute first if you want.
phases.scored_false_reason: Observed but NOT scored. The four parts extract cleanly -- every quote is real text -- but scoring them inverts the ranking: the weakest of four measured answers scored 4/5, above two of the three strong ones (log 9.6). The criteria reward MENTIONING a topic, and 'I don't know how you'd stop that' is indistinguishable from anticipating a failure when both are quotes. Section 7.10 measured `mentions_tradeoff` at 7/10 and called it a genuine judgement call; quoting does not rescue it, because the judgement is in what counts as meeting the criterion, not in finding the text. The report DESCRIBES the design answer instead.
phases.probe_budget_reason: Lowered from 3 in log 9.10. It was raised when the design question drew ZERO probes because a fluent answer read as complete; `design-gap->probe` now guarantees one follow-up deterministically. The adaptive stop does NOT apply here -- a hypothetical has no situation, action or result -- so this budget is the only pacing the question has, and at 3 plus pool it ran to 5 follow-ups and became the longest question in the session, spending reserve the scored phases could have used.
